styleSelection.reason: Sargent's Ships is built from bold, luminous painted value planes and wet-on-dry local colour washes over warm cream paper reserves, with crisp dark hull accents and no ink line work.

families.referenceCue: Sunlit warm cream sail and rigging planes in the upper right; preserve open paper reserves and soft warm ochre transitions.
Broad curving cool slate and cerulean hull sweeping across the center, punctuated by warm ochre/sienna rust accents and the dark hawsehole and anchor assembly.
Warm yellow-ochre and sienna vertical masts, spars, and diagonal rigging planes on the left against pale warm paper.
Lower-left hull curve, warm ochre anchor and timber planes, and cool slate shadow washes descending to the lower-left margin.
Deep blue-slate and dark neutral waterline shadow and hull reflection in the lower center, built in layered dark glazes.
Turquoise-green, sap-green, and warm olive water planes with diagonal spar reflections and reserved sunlit hull planks on the lower right.
